scope: Independent source review and controlled browser/transport tests. Browser media and remote provider leaves are simulated. These checks do not establish live microphone, physical playback, performance or a supported package release.

findings.before: A tagged error from generation 5 resets speaking generation 6 to listening; the next microphone onset sends no interruption on either route.
findings.corrected: The browser rejects the whole old error before changing response state; both routes retain speaking and send one interruption.

findings.before: The SFU checker treats an explicitly tagged generation 2 assistant transcript as the generation 3 answer and schedules completion.
findings.corrected: The checker rejects the old transcript and does not schedule completion without current assistant text.

findings.before: Both the parent and original correction retain speaking internally after reconnect while displaying Listening; idle speech sends a phantom interruption.
findings.corrected: Fresh connection and reset clear response state. The current status received during an awaited SFU publish remains intact.

findings.before: The browser empties queued current audio when a lower-generation clear arrives.
findings.corrected: Both browser pages reject the whole old clear before changing audio ownership. Existing tests also cover the current SFU receiver and old terminal errors.

limitations: Untagged assistant transcripts use the current ordered control-stream response generation; this does not add a generation field to provider events.
Historical evidence and failed live conversational cases remain in their original files.
The proposed silence fallback is not part of the application source in this revision.
